result.stdout:
aios-statistics-ingest — conversation ingestion operation center

Normalizes Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and Gemini conversations into one
SQLite store (+ mirrored JSON) so they can be queried in a single shape.

Commands
  ingest [--source claude|copilot|gemini|all]   Import & normalize (idempotent)
         [--claude DIR] [--copilot DIR] [--gemini TAKEOUT_DIR]
         [--db FILE] [--json DIR] [--no-json]
  list   [--source S] [--limit N]               Recent conversations
  search <query> [--limit N]                    Full-text-ish search over messages
  show   <source> <sourceId>                    Print one transcript
  stats  [--db FILE]                            Counts per source

Defaults: db & json live under AiOS/state/stats-data/.
